page.overview:
Who is Eleyan al'Landerin?

Eleyan al'Landerin was an ancient Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Eleyan al'Landerin}}

There is a statue of her and her Warders in the southwestern side of Tar Valon, in the same place she sacrificed herself with her Warders to stop and repel Artur Hawkwing's army at the beginning of the nineteen-year-long siege to the city.

Her name indicates that she was from the Two Rivers region of Farashelle.

The name of this character comes from the name of a Tarvalon.net member.
